## Theme name

The `name` field from your theme JSON.

## Author

How you want to be credited.

## Screenshot

Attach a screenshot of EntryBox using the theme. Show a few entries of
different types and states so contrast is visible.

## Theme JSON

Paste the full contents of your `themes/<name>.json`, or attach the file.

```json
(theme json here)
```

## Checklist

- [ ] Every `--var` key present in the built-in themes is defined.
- [ ] All five entry types and five states are legible.
- [ ] Tested in both compact and expanded entry views.

> Prefer not to open a PR? You can also publish the JSON anywhere and tag it
> `entrybox-theme` on GitHub so others can find it.
